instruction: Italicize the title on slide 1 and change its font color to red.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully bolded all text on slide 1, changed title to 44pt, and underlined it in 14 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can select text in LibreOffice Impress, apply bold/underline formatting, change font size via character properties panel.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests italic and font color formatting on the same slide 1 title, a related but different formatting task.
metadata.explanation: Getter reads slide 1 title runs for italic and color_rgb properties. Metric awards 0.5 for all runs italic=True and 0.5 for all runs having color FF0000.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts italic and color_rgb properties from all runs of the title shape on slide 1.
Metric correctly checks both requirements: italic (0.5) and red color FF0000 (0.5), with sensible partial credit.
Metric parameter handling is correct: expected.get('expected_color') directly accesses the rules dict as expected when type='rule'.
Postconfig saves the file with Ctrl+S before getter reads, ensuring changes are persisted to disk.
Minor: Getter identifies the title by hardcoded text 'Business Infographic Template', which is file-specific but appropriate for this known file.
Minor: run.font.italic check uses 'is True' which is strict — inherited italic (None) would not match. This is acceptable since explicitly setting italic should produce True.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider using shape.placeholder_format or shape title detection instead of hardcoded text matching for more robust title identification.
